facts.text: Margaret McElhar; born about 1840 at Friary; died 6 Aug 1913 at Cullionboy

Surname recorded as both McElhar and Carr - interchangeable variants of the same surname in common usage within the family and community. Birth record of son Joseph Kelly (1875) gives mother's maiden name as McElhar; later records use Carr. From Friary townland, Lough Eske, Killymard Parish. Death on 6 August 1913 - same date as birth of Rose Kelly, both registered by Mary Anne McGettigan. Preferred birth year ~1840 from marriage record.
Thomas Kelly; born about 1840 at ; died about 1913 at Cullionboy

Birth year ~1840 from marriage record (1864, age 24) and 1901 census. 1911 census notes 45 years married and 8 children born, 3 living. Irish and English speaker (1901). Married Margaret McElhar/Carr 17 February 1864 at Killymard Parish - one of the earliest civil registration records in district. Death record not located.
Thomas Kelly married Margaret McElhar on 17 Feb 1864 at Killymard Parish Church
Thomas Kelly; born about 1871 at Cullionboy
Son of Thomas Kelly and Margaret McElhar/Carr. Present in 1901. Absent from 1911 - likely emigrated or deceased.
Joseph Kelly; born 8 Jun 1875 at Cullionboy; died 27 Dec 1925 at Cullionboy

Died of Pulmonary Tuberculosis aged 47 - same cause as Sarah Gallagher Logue (1918), reflecting prevalence of TB in rural Donegal in this period. Married Isabella McGettigan 6 February 1910 at St. Patrick's Church, Donegal Town. Death confirmed by 1926 census where wife Bella recorded as widow with children noting father dead.
Joseph Kelly married Isabella McGettigan on 6 Feb 1910 at St. Patrick's Church, Donegal Town
Isabella McGettigan; born 6 Feb 1879 at Druminnin; died 5 May 1954 at Cullionboy

Known as Bella. Born at Druminnin (family home), father recorded on birth certificate as Hugh Gaitens - earlier anglicisation of McGettigan. Catherine McAna present at birth - relationship to Mary McAna unknown, possibly sister but unproven. Married Joseph Kelly on her 31st birthday, 6 February 1910. Several children born at maternal grandmother's home in Mullinalamphry. Surname variants: McGettigan / Gaitens / Gaitins.
John Patrick Kelly; born about 1881 at Cullionboy
Brother of Joseph Kelly. Son of Thomas Kelly and Margaret McElhar/Carr.
James Kelly; born about 1883 at Cullionboy
Son of Thomas Kelly and Margaret McElhar/Carr. Present in 1901. Absent from 1911. Note: 1911 records only 3 of 8 children living.
Mary Katie Kelly; born about 1913 at Mullinalamphry
Daughter of Joseph Kelly and Bella McGettigan.
Rosanna Kelly; born 30 Jul 1913 at Mullinalamphry

Preferred name Rose - used throughout her life and signed on official documents including mother Bella's death registration 1954. Full given name Rosanna confirmed by birth record. Born at maternal grandmother Mary McAna's home in Mullinalamphry while family home was Cullionboy - several of Bella's children born at the McGettigan/McAna household. Birth date: family oral tradition gives 30 July 1913; civil registration date of 6 August 1913 likely reflects registration date rather than birth date.
